description: Insider positions from SEC Form 3/4/5 filings: one row per holding line reported by a director, officer or 10%+ owner. Source: SEC's quarterly bulk Form 3/4/5 data set, 2006 on. Shares and value are as of the filing (after its transaction), not live. A ticker search also returns the issuer's rows under symbols it no longer lists or another issuer's symbol (on its CIK): ticker is as filed; see current_ticker and issuer_relation. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_insider_holdings

company_name.description: Substring; 1-3 characters match a whole word.

holding_type.description: nonderiv: e.g. common stock; deriv: options, RSUs, warrants, convertibles.

merge_co_reports.description: Default true: a position co-owners each report is one row naming every filer; false: one row per filing (double-counts).

name: get_insider_holdings
